title: How Car Air Conditioning Works in 60 Seconds ❄️🚗 #shorts
description:
Your car's AC doesn't make cold, it moves heat out of the cabin. A compressor squeezes refrigerant into a hot gas, the condenser up front dumps that heat into the outside air, and an expansion valve drops the pressure so the liquid gets icy. In the evaporator behind the dash it boils, soaking up heat from the air the fan blows into the car. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#caraircon #ac #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Your car's AC doesn't make cold. It *moves heat* out of the car.

steps.label: Compressor
steps.text: The engine spins a *compressor* that squeezes refrigerant into a *hot, high-pressure gas*.

steps.label: Condenser
steps.text: Up front, the *condenser* dumps that heat into the outside air, and the gas turns *liquid*.

steps.label: Valve
steps.text: An *expansion valve* suddenly drops the pressure, and the liquid gets *icy cold*.

steps.label: Evaporator
steps.text: Behind the dash it boils in the *evaporator*, around *minus 30 degrees* at low pressure.

steps.label: Fan
steps.text: A *fan* blows cabin air across the cold fins, and *cool air* comes out the vents.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Squeeze, cool, *boil*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
